text:
The median asking rent in Dortmund sits at 9.7 €/m², with a year‑on‑year rise of 2.4 % and a five‑year gain of 23.2 %. The inter‑quartile range spans 8.4 €/m² to 11.19 €/m², placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive markets.

Market tightness is moderate: properties stay on the market for 33 days and 22 % are let within a week, while the vacancy rate is 2.1 %. Rent burden for a two‑person household averages 14.4 % and the asking premium over existing rents is 50 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing 582 €/month.

The model‑based forecast expects median asking rents to reach 10.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m² – a 6.2 % increase.
